title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for the number of collisions per second must be correctly stated as approximately 5 x 10^25 s^-1.

title: Average Velocity
description: Important Criteria: The calculation of the average velocity using the formula sqrt(8kT/pi m) must be correctly derived.

title: Pressure and Density
description: Important Criteria: The use of the correct values for pressure and the number density of the gas at STP must be included in the calculations.

title: Area Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The area of one wall of the cube must be correctly calculated as 10 cm x 10 cm.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The units used throughout the calculations should be consistent and correctly converted where necessary.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any sign mistakes or incorrect factors in the final expression for N will result in a deduction.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: Consideration of limiting cases or assumptions made in the model should be discussed.
